Title: Ron's Gone Wrong
Director: Sarah Smith, Jean-Philippe Vine, Octavio E. Rodriguez
Actors: Jack Dylan Grazer, Zach Galifianakis, Ed Helms
Plot: The story of Barney, an awkward middle-schooler and Ron, his new walking, talking, digitally-connected device. Ron's malfunctions set against the backdrop of the social media age launch them on a journey to learn about true friend...
